verdict.rationale: Discord's first-party docs describe several official SDKs. The Embedded App SDK lets developers ship web apps and games inside Discord. The Discord Social SDK has getting-started guides for C++, Unity, Unreal Engine, iOS and Android, plus in-depth development guides for account linking, provisional accounts and relationships. Missing for 10: no evidence of an official general-purpose SDK for bots and the REST/Gateway API (those are documented only as raw API, with no OpenAPI spec found), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDKs.
